title: Access Control Lists: Firewall Fundamentals

steps.objective: Enter privileged mode to explore ACL concepts
steps.teachingPoint: ACLs filter traffic based on source/destination IP, protocol, and ports
ACLs appear in config as 'access-list' statements

legacyCommands: ! Apply ACL inbound on WAN interface:
! - ACL 1-99: Standard (filters by source IP only)
! - ACL 100-199: Extended (filters by source, dest, protocol, port)
! - 'permit ospf any any' - Allow OSPF routing updates
! - 'deny icmp host X.X.X.X any' - Block ping from specific host
! - Implicit 'deny any' at end of every ACL
